name: egg_appear
use: the egg materialises in the dark room (t = 0)

name: egg_knock_1
use: heartbeat knock from inside the egg, accelerates before the opening (pitch rises in code)

name: egg_knock_2
use: heartbeat knock, second variant

name: egg_riser_forest
use: prep of the forest egg: rustle and wood tension, climax at t = prep

name: egg_riser_amber
use: prep of the amber egg: warm brass swell and gong shimmer

name: egg_riser_tide
use: prep of the tide egg: bubbles speed up, water rush

name: egg_riser_storm
use: prep of the storm egg: electric build-up, rumble

name: egg_riser_astral
use: prep of the astral egg: shimmering glissando, choir swell

name: egg_crack_1
use: the shell cracks open at t = prep

name: egg_crack_2
use: the shell cracks open, variant with a longer cascade

name: egg_boom_s
use: impact of the opening, size s (small for low rarities, large for high)

name: egg_boom_m
use: impact of the opening, size m (small for low rarities, large for high)

name: egg_boom_l
use: impact of the opening, size l (small for low rarities, large for high)

name: egg_burst_s
use: magic burst when the shell opens, size s

name: egg_burst_m
use: magic burst when the shell opens, size m

name: egg_burst_l
use: magic burst when the shell opens, size l

name: egg_thunder
use: thunder for high rarities at the opening (and the storm egg)

name: egg_divine
use: the biggest hit: top rarity opening (sub drop, choir, cymbal, bells)

name: forest_snap_1
use: forest egg: a belt segment splinters (8 in a row, pitch rises in code)

name: forest_snap_2
use: forest egg: belt segment splinters, second variant

name: forest_leaves
use: forest egg: burst of leaf cubes and soft sparks

name: forest_shimmer
use: forest egg: soft rising sparkles while sparks rise around the egg (loop)

name: amber_note
use: amber egg: a segment of the sun lights up (6 notes, pitch steps up the scale in code)

name: amber_inflow
use: amber egg: sparks fly toward the egg (loop)

name: amber_sun
use: amber egg: the sun ring swells (warm gong and pad)

name: amber_shard_1
use: amber egg: an amber shard flies off a segment (6 in a row)

name: amber_shard_2
use: amber egg: amber shard, second variant

name: tide_bubbles
use: tide egg: bubbles rise around the egg (loop)

name: tide_splash
use: tide egg: the splash when the shell opens (rings and droplets)

name: tide_pop_1
use: tide egg: a pearl row bursts into bubbles (4 pops, pitch rises in code)

name: tide_pop_2
use: tide egg: bubble pop, second variant

name: tide_ring
use: tide egg: water ring pulse

name: storm_crackle
use: storm egg: sparks along the seam, accelerating (one long rising crackle)

name: storm_zap_1
use: storm egg: a bolt across the seam / from the centre

name: storm_zap_2
use: storm egg: bolt, second variant

name: storm_clamp
use: storm egg: a steel clamp releases (6 in a row)

name: storm_thunder
use: storm egg: the thunder flash at the opening (sharper crack, long rumble)

name: storm_arcs
use: storm egg: arcs between the separated armour segments (loop)

name: astral_twinkle
use: astral egg: stars twinkle around the egg (loop)

name: astral_ring
use: astral egg: the rings align (resonant chord of bells, sub hum)

name: astral_burst
use: astral egg: stars fly to all sides (whoosh, dense sparkle, soft choir)

name: astral_split
use: astral egg: the shell separates (resonant sweep, glass crack, shimmer)

name: egg_flash
use: light flash from inside the egg: a rising airy shine and a bright ping

name: egg_ring_s
use: shock ring on the floor, small

name: egg_ring_l
use: shock ring on the floor, large

name: pet_emerge
use: the animal pops out of the shell: spring boing, upward whoosh, sparkle

name: pet_trail
use: sparkle trail while the animal is in the air (loop)

name: pet_land_s
use: the animal lands, size s (by rarity)

name: pet_land_m
use: the animal lands, size m (by rarity)

name: pet_land_l
use: the animal lands, size l (by rarity)

name: pet_slowmo
use: slow motion at the jump of high rarities (the world slows down and speeds up)

name: egg_shafts
use: light shafts appear (rarity 3 and up): a soft vowel swell and high bells

name: egg_halo
use: halo of the mythic and divine rarities: choir, strings and bells

name: egg_orbit
use: the camera circles the animal (divine rarity): two passes of air

name: pet_tap_1
use: tap on the animal: a cheerful boop going up

name: pet_tap_2
use: tap on the animal: a boop going down

name: egg_skip
use: SKIP pressed: a quick whoosh and a soft thud

name: egg_reveal_0
use: reveal stinger, rarity 0 (Common): three glockenspiel notes and a soft pad

name: egg_reveal_1
use: reveal stinger, rarity 1 (Uncommon): harp arpeggio, celesta, pad

name: egg_reveal_2
use: reveal stinger, rarity 2 (Rare): bell fanfare, brass swell, harp run

name: egg_reveal_3
use: reveal stinger, rarity 3 (Epic): timpani roll into a brass hit with choir

name: egg_reveal_4
use: reveal stinger, rarity 4 (Legendary): orchestral hit, choir, cymbal crash, bell cascade

name: egg_reveal_5
use: reveal stinger, rarity 5 (Mythic): two hits, modulation up to D major

name: egg_reveal_6
use: reveal stinger, rarity 6 (Divine): brass fanfare, roll, huge choir hit, bell cascade

name: egg_card
use: the reveal card slams onto the screen

name: egg_new
use: NEW PET: a rising triple ping with sparkle

name: egg_dupe
use: DUPLICATE: two glass clinks and shard sparkle

name: egg_music_a
use: music under the reveal card, calm (rarities 0-3), loops, C-Am-F-G

name: egg_music_b
use: music under the reveal card, grand (rarities 4-6), loops, D-Bm-G-A with choir and timpani

name: egg_surge
use: music build-up while the animal jumps (from emerge to reveal): arpeggio, strings, roll, riser
